title: Choosing a present
instructions: Ben ve Lucy arkadaşları için hediye seçiyor. Önerileri, reddedilenleri ve son kararı takip et.

script.speaker: ben
script.text: It's Ali's birthday on Saturday. What shall we buy him?

script.speaker: lucy
script.text: What about a book? He reads a lot.

script.speaker: ben
script.text: Yes, but he has hundreds of books. It's difficult to choose one he hasn't read.

script.speaker: lucy
script.text: True. What about a T-shirt from his favourite football team?

script.speaker: ben
script.text: He already has three. I think he'd like something different.

script.speaker: lucy
script.text: He started cooking lessons last month, didn't he?

script.speaker: ben
script.text: Yes! He loves them. Let's buy him a cooking book and some good knives.

script.speaker: lucy
script.text: Knives are expensive. Maybe just the cooking book and a nice apron.

script.speaker: ben
script.text: Good idea. How much shall we spend?

script.speaker: ben
script.text: OK, sixty pounds together. Let's go to the shop after work.

questions.prompt: Why don't they buy a football T-shirt?
questions.feedback: Zaten üç tane (already has three) var.

questions.prompt: What are they going to buy?
options: a cooking book and some knives
a cooking book and an apron
questions.feedback: Bıçaklar pahalı; yemek kitabı ve önlük (apron) alacaklar.
questions.evidence: Maybe just the cooking book and a nice apron.

questions.prompt: How much will they spend together?
questions.feedback: Kişi başı otuz; birlikte altmış pound (sixty pounds).
